apiNamedQueryParameters.description: Salesforce Id of the Account to get details for

ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Type, Phone, Website, NumberOfEmployees, OwnerId, (SELECT Id FROM Contacts) FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountid
ApiNamedQuery.description: Gets key details for one Account (industry, type, phone, website, employee count, owner) plus its Contacts as a nested list -- the number of Contacts is the length of that nested list, no separate count call needed.
